# SIM+ Campus 0.7 — Excel Student Workspace

Unofficial GL Bajaj / AKTU Android companion. Built on SIM+ 0.6. No fabricated academic data.

## On first launch

1. Tap **Import Excel (.xlsx)**. Select a spreadsheet stored on the device.
2. The workbook must have the **13 columns below in this exact order** on any worksheet. Column headings are case and punctuation tolerant but order is strict. The first heading row should be within the first ten worksheet rows.
3. The app imports real rows locally (up to 2,500 students, 8 MB ZIP input), encrypts the roster with Android Keystore AES-GCM, and preselects the first student. The active student can be changed from the dropdown on every screen.
4. The selected profile is used for name, roll number, DOB, category, addresses, course, semester, session, photograph URL, report and AKTU roll/DOB autofill. The app does **not** store a college ERP password or solve CAPTCHA.

| # | Excel header |
|---|---|
| 1 | Name |
| 2 | University Roll No |
| 3 | Admission No |
| 4 | Father's Name |
| 5 | Date of Birth |
| 6 | Year of Admission |
| 7 | Category |
| 8 | Course |
| 9 | Current Semester |
| 10 | Session |
| 11 | Correspondence Address (Parents) |
| 12 | Permanent Address (Parents) |
| 13 | Photo URL |

**DOB** may be an Excel date, `dd/MM/yyyy`, or `yyyy-MM-dd`. For the photo, supply a reachable, direct HTTPS image URL. Otherwise the PDF displays "Photo unavailable." Links to webpages that require login or prohibit direct image downloads cannot be embedded.

## Data isolation and authentication

Each selected student has separate attendance and result caches. Switching students clears the existing college/AKTU browser cookies and requires reauthentication to SIM. Selecting a roster student **does not grant access to that student's ERP account**; use that student's authorized credentials, solve the official CAPTCHA, and verify the ERP is logged into the corresponding roll number. If the ERP result page exposes a different roll number, result capture is refused.

## Report

**Profile → Generate comprehensive PDF**. It includes the full imported profile (DOB, addresses, photo URL and embedded photo where accessible), plus semester-wise saved SIM and AKTU results grouped by subject code with AKTU / ST1 / ST2 / PUT / Other columns. If no results were captured, the report explicitly states that, rather than inventing marks. Attendance is excluded as previously requested. The roster and photos are never uploaded to an app backend. A photo download makes a direct request to the specified HTTPS host only when exporting or displaying.

## Build

Open as a Gradle Android project. Java 17, compileSdk 35, Gradle 8.10.2.

Security/privacy: Do not place a roster containing student DOBs, addresses or photo links in a public GitHub repository. The source code contains no real student roster.
